faq.question: How long does a typical home build take?
faq.answer: Most residential builds take between 6-12 months, depending on complexity and design.

faq.question: Do you provide design services?
faq.answer: Yes, we offer comprehensive design and architectural consultation as part of our building services.

faq.question: Are you licensed and insured?
faq.answer: Absolutely. We're fully licensed, insured, and compliant with all Queensland building regulations.

faq.question: What areas do you service?
faq.answer: We primarily service Brisbane and surrounding suburbs, including Bulimba, New Farm, and Hawthorne.

faq.question: How do I get a quote?
faq.answer: Contact us for a free, no-obligation consultation and detailed project quote.
